name: wan2gp-minipaint-bridge
description: Lets the a1111-mini-paint-NEO extension ask this WanGP what image inputs it can accept right now, hand it one PNG at a time, and add the live page - with a prompt or images overridden for that one request - to WanGP's own queue, starting the run through WanGP's own generate trigger when WanGP is idle and joining the running one otherwise, and report where the tasks a page admitted are in WanGP's queue. Adds no generation UI, never presses Generate while a generation is running, never aborts one, and changes no generation behaviour - except that, when the extension asks, it holds WanGP between two tasks (the task running finishes, the next waits) so another extension can use the card for a while, and lets it go again. Also answers an authenticated loopback control surface so the extension can compose, submit, follow and cancel a generation with no page open, and can commit the live settings form on request so a job queued from another tab runs at what was on screen. Its page script answers the parent page's heartbeat on the spot and, when asked, says when somebody touches the form, so the parent can save it as it changes. Its stylesheet dresses WanGP in the colours the parent sends - the Forge page's own, or the bridge's built-in dark and light - over whichever theme WanGP's own settings picked, and steps aside when the parent says off; it sets the page in the parent page's own typeface, faces included. While the parent's focus mode gives the WanGP tab the whole window, it hides what sits above the generator form - the title, the main tab strip, the model row and the model's description - and shows them again when focus ends.
author: a1111-mini-paint-NEO

compatibility.note: The version range is an early filter only. Real compatibility is functional: the bridge resolves its components through the plugin API and reports ready=false with BRIDGE_COMPONENT_INCOMPATIBLE when a mandatory one is missing.
